req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-017 states the system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field. Three test cases are designed: (1) Positive/EP — omit description entirely, verify 201 and null description in response; (2) Negative/NEG — send description=null explicitly (valid per schema, same path) vs send an invalid payload missing title to confirm 422 error path; (3) Boundary/BVA — send description field at its max length (500 chars) and at 501 chars to confirm the boundary enforcement. Each test is self-contained, uses in-process TestClient, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process with TestClient
tasks table contains exactly 20 pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with payload {"title": "No desc task"} (no description key)
trace: R-TASK-017: system shall accept POST /tasks/ without description field
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_without_description_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "No desc task"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "No desc task"
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] == 21
    assert "created_at" in body

test_create_task_without_description_returns_201()

tests.name: test_create_task_description_at_max_length_boundary
preconditions: App is running in-process with TestClient
tasks table contains exactly 20 pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with description of exactly 500 characters (no description key omitted — boundary at max)
POST /tasks/ with description of exactly 501 characters (one over boundary)
expected: First request (500 chars): HTTP 201, description in response equals the 500-char string
Second request (501 chars): HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity
trace: R-TASK-017: boundary value at description max_length=500 per schemas.TaskBase
BVA: test at N and N+1 to catch off-by-one mutations on max_length constant
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_description_at_max_length_boundary():
    client = TestClient(app)
    desc_500 = "x" * 500
    r_ok = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "BVA task 500", "description": desc_500})
    assert r_ok.status_code == 201
    body_ok = r_ok.json()
    assert body_ok["description"] == desc_500
    assert len(body_ok["description"]) == 500
    assert body_ok["title"] == "BVA task 500"
    desc_501 = "x" * 501
    r_bad = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "BVA task 501", "description": desc_501})
    assert r_bad.status_code == 422
    body_bad = r_bad.json()
    assert "detail" in body_bad

test_create_task_description_at_max_length_boundary()

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description_persisted_correctly
preconditions: App is running in-process with TestClient
tasks table contains exactly 20 pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ without description to create task
GET /tasks/{id} to verify the created task is persisted with null description
expected: GET response title matches posted title
trace: R-TASK-017: state transition — task created without description transitions to persisted state with null description
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_without_description_persisted_correctly():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Persist no desc"})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    created = r_create.json()
    assert created["id"] == 21
    assert created["description"] is None
    task_id = created["id"]
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    fetched = r_get.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == 21
    assert fetched["title"] == "Persist no desc"
    assert fetched["description"] is None
    assert fetched["completed"] == False

test_create_task_without_description_persisted_correctly()
